recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, cel-shaded illustration of a group of four distinct cartoon characters riding in a camouflage-patterned off-road buggy against a stark white background. The art style features heavy black outlines, flat color fills with minimal shading, and a gritty, urban aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters are tightly packed within the vehicle frame
The buggy is angled in a three-quarter perspective facing right
The vibrant green camouflage contrasts against the neutral white void
Graffiti-style lettering sits low and overlaps the vehicle's front tire
coreInvariants: Camouflage pattern on the vehicle body

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The vehicle and characters occupy the central 70% of the frame, slightly offset to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large front-left tire serves as the primary visual anchor in the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the characters' faces down the hood of the car to the graffiti text in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central cluster, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Military greens and olives define the vehicle and character clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks provide structural outlines and shadow depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted reds and yellows appear in small details like lights and patches.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-mid saturation with high value contrast against the white background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy tones and industrial greens

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Irregular, expressive sans-serif with varying weights
letterConstructionRules: Simulated spray-paint texture with soft edges
Varying baseline heights for a rhythmic, unstable look
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final 'z' is elongated and stylized with a horizontal strike
Circular counters are filled or heavily narrowed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the expressive graffiti with a rigid, geometric sans-serif for metadata blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the urban, rebellious aesthetic of the character group

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cel-shaded illustration of a camouflage off-road buggy with four stylized urban characters inside, isolated on a pure white background. Use thick black outlines and a desaturated green palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a hand-drawn red graffiti-style logo in the bottom left corner, ensuring it has a soft spray-paint texture and slightly overlaps the front tire.

verificationChecks: Is the text rendered with a soft, spray-painted edge?
Does the vehicle feature a distinct camouflage pattern?
Are the character outlines thick and consistent?
Is the background completely white and devoid of scenery?

mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid IP infringement
postGenerationChecks: Check for line weight consistency across characters and vehicle
Ensure the red text is legible despite the spray effect
Verify the three-quarter perspective is anatomically plausible for the vehicle
Confirm no background elements were generated
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Urban Character Group] + [Camouflage Vehicle] + [White Void] + [Spray Paint Typography] for a consistent street-art aesthetic.
